The 2026 Texas Commissioner of Agriculture election will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the agriculture comissioner of Texas. The primary election took place on March 3, 2026. Incumbent commissioner Sid Miller ran for re-election to a fourth term in office, but was defeated in the Republican primary by Nate Sheets.
